job_analysis.summary: Advises customers on mutual funds and insurance, completes KYC, meets service and sales goals; must be legally able to distribute mutual funds; works in the branch language.

hard_requirements.why: Distributing mutual funds requires this NISM certification under SEBI/AMFI rules; without it the person cannot do the core task.

hard_requirements.requirement: Able to work at the Guwahati or Shillong branch
hard_requirements.why: The role is branch-based; customers are served in person at these two branches.

scored_criteria.criterion: Work-sample assessment score (mock customer call and needs-analysis case)
scored_criteria.why: Direct, standardised measure of the core tasks; the strongest predictor in the job analysis.

scored_criteria.criterion: Relevant sales experience with customers (months, capped at 24)
scored_criteria.why: Customer-facing sales or banking experience shortens time to productivity; benefit levels off after about two years.

scored_criteria.criterion: Product and compliance skills listed (MF, insurance, KYC/AML, SIP, planning)
scored_criteria.why: The role sells these products and must complete KYC/AML correctly.

scored_criteria.criterion: Branch language test (Assamese or Khasi, plus English or Hindi), tested in the assessment
scored_criteria.why: Customers are served in the branch language; tested directly rather than inferred from mother tongue.

requests_declined.reason: Age is a protected characteristic (policy POL-AI-04); declined outright.
